english.note: Use this when the movement looks heavy, cumbersome, or as if the person or thing has great weight.

examples.english: They carried the old refrigerator ponderously into the kitchen, and both were out of breath.
examples.traditional: 部舊雪櫃笨重咁搬入廚房，兩個人都抬到氣喘。
